Maryland Democrats are calling a special session to amend the state constitution regarding redistricting, aiming to counter GOP gerrymandering elsewhere.

The Poison:
This arms race erodes public trust in the electoral process, turning maps into weapons rather than representations of the people.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in Q4 (WHY). The stated 'why' is protecting voters, but the actual 'why' is securing a partisan monopoly on House seats.

Social Physics Analysis:
This is a textbook example of a 'Smart Selfish Loop.' The party uses a high-minded pretext (Voting Rights Act) to justify a power-hoarding action (gerrymandering), projecting the 'aggressor' label onto the GOP.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. The system prioritizes power over democratic representation.

The Unavoidable Truth: Both parties are using redistricting to eliminate opposition.

The Unavoidable Lie: This is about creating a 'durable, transparent framework.'

Alethekanon:
When the rules of the game are rewritten by the players to ensure their own victory, the game itself ceases to be democratic.

It is so sad to see our democracy treated like a game of chess. We deserve maps that bring us together, not ones that divide us for power.
